title: Maximum Sum of Non-Overlapping Subarrays of Length K
statement: Given an array of integers and an integer k, find the maximum sum obtainable by selecting any number of non-overlapping subarrays, each of exactly length k. Subarrays must not share any indices.
summary: Find the maximum sum obtainable by selecting non-overlapping subarrays of fixed length k.
